title: Enchanted Rat Experiment
summary: Use three enchanted rats to cure a randomized board before time expires.
overview: Give Velarte the research briefing at the appropriate badge quest stage. A random four-by-four board appears and an 18-minute timer begins.
Trade each filled rat jar to an empty tile. The released rat cures diseased rats in straight cardinal lines when they lie between it and the nearest healthy rat in that direction.
Use all three jars, cure every diseased rat, and return the three empty jars together to Velarte before the experiment times out.

sections.title: Experiment supplies
paragraphs: Bring the briefing and all three filled jars before starting. Empty jars are returned when the rats are placed.
